_note: 2026-10-17: a verifiable dusk view of the Băneasa terminal and tower (bbu-page-3) is published; earlier wrong-airport images remain skipped.

bbu-page-3.webp.zh: 暮色中的伯尼亚萨机场：蓝色航站楼与塔台亮着灯，机坪上停着巴士与一架客机。
bbu-page-3.webp.en: Băneasa at dusk — the blue terminal and tower lit up, buses and an airliner on the apron.

bbu-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝色的弧形航站楼顶上立着一串大写字母，写着布加勒斯特伯尼亚萨的机场名，楼前停着一辆白色货车。
bbu-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Above the curved blue terminal a long row of capitals spells the Bucharest Băneasa name, with a white van waiting outside.

bbu-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 俯瞰机场：圆顶的环形航站楼居中，塔台与长条形办公楼围在四周，前方是大片草地和停满汽车的停车场。
bbu-chatgpt-02.webp.en: From above, the round domed terminal sits at the centre, ringed by the tower and long office blocks, with a wide lawn and packed car parks in front.

bbu-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 晴空下，一架黄色单翼特技飞机停在水泥机坪上，塔台与环形的奥雷尔·弗拉伊库航站楼在它身后。
bbu-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A yellow single-seat aerobatic aircraft rests on the concrete apron, the control tower and the round Aurel Vlaicu terminal behind it under a cloud-streaked sky.

bbu-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 米黄色的弧形航站楼伸展开来，深色玻璃穹顶压在中段，蓝色字母牌标出弗拉伊库的名字，塔台从屋顶后探出。
bbu-chatgpt-04.webp.en: The pale yellow terminal sweeps around, its dark glass dome set mid-curve, blue letters naming Aurel Vlaicu and the tower rising just behind the roofline.

bbu-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 夜里，一架深蓝与银白涂装的喷气公务机停在泛光灯照亮的机坪上，橙红色锥筒摆在四周，塔台在后方亮着灯。
bbu-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A blue and silver business jet stands on the apron at night, lit by floodlights with orange cones around it and the illuminated tower behind.

bbu-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架涡桨飞机的机翼与螺旋桨压在上方，下方是蓝色航站楼、塔台和人群，楼顶写着布加勒斯特伯尼亚萨。
bbu-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A turboprop's wing and propeller loom over the frame, below them the blue terminal, tower and a gathered crowd beneath the Bucharest Băneasa lettering.

bbu-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 宽幅画面里，一架白色公务机停在机坪右侧，环形的航站楼与塔台在左侧排开，晴朗天空下投下清晰的影子。
bbu-chatgpt-07.webp.en: In a wide frame a white business jet sits on the right of the apron while the round terminal and tower line the left, sharp shadows under a clear sky.
